Class InsertStopCommand

Namespace
TwinSharp.CNC
Assembly
TwinSharp.dll

Allows insertion of CNC stop marks into a running NC program at runtime via the HLI bahn_mc_control.insert_cmd control unit.

In POSITION mode (logicalAxisNumber > 0 in InsertAtPosition(double, uint)) the CNC stops the first time the specified axis reaches the commanded position. The stop behaves like M00 — the operator presses Continue to resume.

Requires P-STUP-00033 (fb_storage_size) to be non-zero on the machine.

GetDistanceOfNextStopMm()

Reads the absolute path distance (dist_prog_start) at which the CNC will trigger the next stop, in mm. Returns -1 if no stop has been found yet in the look-ahead buffer (the stop may still be found as more blocks are pre-processed).

InsertAtAbsoluteDistance(double)

Inserts a one-shot M00 stop at an absolute cumulative path distance of absoluteDistMm mm from the program start. Uses DISTANCE mode (axis_nr = 0) with rel_abs_mode = 1 (one-off absolute distance from the program start).

public void InsertAtAbsoluteDistance(double absoluteDistMm)

Parameters

absoluteDistMm double

Absolute path distance from program start in mm.

InsertAtPosition(double, uint)

Inserts a one-shot absolute stop (M00) the first time logicalAxisNumber reaches positionMm. If the program is already past that position the stop is triggered immediately.

public void InsertAtPosition(double positionMm, uint logicalAxisNumber)

Parameters

positionMm double

Target axis position in mm.

logicalAxisNumber uint

Logical axis number (> 0). Use the X-axis logical number for a marker-based stop.

InsertAtRelativeDistance(double)

Inserts a one-shot M00 stop after the CNC's path interpolator has traveled remainingMm more mm from its current position. Uses DISTANCE mode (axis_nr = 0) with rel_abs_mode = 2 (one-off relative distance from the current interpolator position).

public void InsertAtRelativeDistance(double remainingMm)

Parameters

remainingMm double

Distance to travel before stopping, in mm.
